hero.title: IE FUSHIMI
hero.line: An old house. A new chapter.

lines: On an old street leading towards Fushimi Inari stands a traditional Kyoto house.
Its timber carries the marks of those who built it.
Water rises from wells beneath it.
Beyond its rooms, a garden changes quietly with the seasons.
Today, the house has another life.
People gather, discover and sometimes stay longer than they intended.
A House of Tea in Fushimi, Kyoto.
